第二十一章 灵狐归形符镇剑煞（第1页）
黑风峡谷的历练落下帷幕，一行人安然返回别院。经此一战，伴在陈默身侧的小白狐早已今非昔比，此前在峡谷深处机缘巧合吞噬火莲，成功炼化精纯火焰之力，一身灵力充盈饱满，运转自如。
只见它周身淡淡赤红光晕流转，皮毛下潜藏的火焰气息缓缓内敛，原本凝出的战斗形态随之舒展。灵光一卷，身形从容收缩，片刻间便从矫健的战姿变回巴掌大小的雪白模样。蓬松的狐毛柔顺光亮，双耳灵动竖起，赤红色的眼眸灵动狡黠，周身火焰气息收放随心，不见半分疲惫狼狈，只透着一股凝练过后的灵动锐气。它轻盈一跃，落在陈默肩头，尾巴轻轻扫过他的脸颊，亲昵又活泼。
次日清晨，陈默安顿好灵狐，准时前往拜见师尊韩东。师徒二人简单交代历练经过，顺带解答几处修行上的小疑惑，问答寥寥数语，一笔带过。
谈及峡谷里那位不幸殒命的少女，韩东面容冷淡，神色未有半分起伏，语气疏离漠然：“修行之路本就弱肉强食，生死皆是常态，不必为无关之人扰乱道心。”
在他眼中，凡俗性命不值一提，生离死别早已看淡。
一旁的韩清鸢却心生恻隐，轻轻蹙眉，软声说道：“叔父，她只是个努力求生的修士，落得这般下场实在可怜。”说着她看向陈默，语气温和地安抚，“师弟，你亲眼目睹惨剧，心里定然不好受，别把心事积压在心底。”
陈默微微拱手：“多谢师姐挂念，弟子省得。”
韩东无意再多谈论此事，抬手示意他退下：“回去静心巩固修为，莫要分心旁事。”
辞别二人，陈默带着小白狐回到厢房，关好门窗，布下隔绝气息与神识的结界。小白狐乖巧蜷在桌角，时而甩动尾巴，周身若有若无的火灵气安稳内敛。陈默深吸一口气，取出那柄自峡谷所得的阴魄剑。
剑身通体漆黑，吸纳所有光线，刺骨的阴煞之气缓缓弥散，剑体内部无数亡魂虚影沉浮涌动。他凝神运转灵力注入剑身，长剑当即发出低沉嗡鸣，一道漆黑剑气无声劈出，威力凶悍绝伦。可剑中汹涌戾气也随之反噬，顺着经脉直扑识海，搅得心神躁动，杀念翻涌。
几番尝试下来皆是如此，宝剑威力极强，可煞气侵扰始终无法规避，他始终不敢全力催动。
就在他暗自思索对策时，房门无风自开，韩东与韩清鸢循着外泄的阴煞气息走了进来。
韩清鸢望见黑剑，面露讶异：“这柄剑阴气如此浓重，难怪师弟难以驾驭。”
陈默连忙收剑行礼：“师尊，师姐。此剑戾气极重，弟子一全力运功便会被煞气侵扰心神，还请师尊指点。”
韩东目光落在阴魄剑上，方才面对生死的冷漠荡然无存，眼底浮起明显的欣喜。他上前隔空探查片刻，缓缓开口道：“此乃上品灵剑阴魄剑，以亡魂煞气铸炼而成，剑气可噬魂伤神，在暗夜与阴地之中威力还能再增三分，是难得的杀伐至宝。”
“只是剑内戾气滔天，以你如今的修为，神魂难以抵挡侵蚀，这便是你束手束脚的缘由。”
话音未落，韩东抬手一拂，一枚泛着莹白柔光的符箓飘到陈默掌心。

“这是下品法器净心符。”他语气平淡，“贴身佩戴，符箓会持续散发出清灵之气，稳固你的识海，隔绝剑中煞气与心魔。有它相助，你便可放开手脚，全力施展此剑，无需再担心心神被扰。”
陈默握紧手中温润的符箓，只觉一股清净之力缓缓流淌周身，当即躬身深拜：“多谢师尊赐符！”
“这下难题便彻底解决了。”韩清鸢面露笑意，由衷为他高兴，“师弟有此宝物相助，日后实力定能大增。”
韩东微微颔首，叮嘱道：“机缘难得，好生炼化宝剑，勤修不辍，莫负造化。”
陈默应声领命。桌角的小白狐抬了抬脑袋，晃了晃毛茸茸的尾巴，周身火焰气息轻轻一荡，似也为主人感到欢喜。
如今灵狐身怀火莲之力、收放自如，手中有阴魄利剑，身上有净心符镇煞，他再无后顾之忧，终于可以安心钻研这柄异剑，踏稳脚下的修行之路。

Chapter 21 The spirit fox returns to form to suppress the sword evil spirit (page 1)
The experience in Black Wind Canyon came to an end, and the group returned to the other courtyard safely. After this battle, the little white fox who accompanied Chen Mo was no longer what he used to be. He had swallowed the fire lotus by chance deep in the canyon and successfully refined the power of pure flames. His spiritual power was full and flowing freely.
I saw a faint red halo flowing around its body, the fire breath hidden under its fur slowly restrained, and the originally condensed fighting form stretched out. With a flash of spiritual light, his figure calmly shrank, and in a moment he changed from a vigorous fighting posture back to a snow-white appearance the size of a palm. The fluffy fox fur was soft and shiny, his ears were erect, his crimson eyes were smart and cunning, and the flame aura around his body was relaxed and relaxed at will. There was no trace of fatigue and embarrassment, only a condensed agility and vigor. It jumped lightly and landed on Chen Mo's shoulder, its tail gently brushing his cheek, intimate and lively.
Early the next morning, Chen Mo settled down with Linghu and went to see Master Han Dong on time. The master and the apprentice briefly explained their experience and experience, and answered a few minor doubts about their practice. The questions and answers were summarized in a few words.
Talking about the unfortunate girl who died in the canyon, Han Dong's face was cold, his expression did not change at all, and his tone was distant and indifferent: "The path of cultivation is inherently about the jungle. Life and death are normal. There is no need to disturb the Taoist mind for irrelevant people."
In his eyes, ordinary life is not worth mentioning, and life and death have long been taken lightly.
Han Qingyuan, who was on the side, felt pity, frowned slightly, and said softly: "Uncle, she was just a monk who worked hard to survive. It is really pitiful that she ended up like this." She looked at Chen Mo and comforted her gently, "Junior brother, you must feel uncomfortable after witnessing the tragedy with your own eyes. Don't keep your worries in your heart."
Chen Mo slightly cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, senior sister, for caring about me. Disciple, I'll spare you the trouble."
Han Dong had no intention of talking about the matter any more, and raised his hand to signal him to step aside: "Go back and consolidate your cultivation. Don't be distracted."
After bidding farewell to the two of them, Chen Mo took the little white fox back to the wing, closed the doors and windows, and put up a barrier to isolate the breath and consciousness. The little white fox curled up obediently at the corner of the table, swishing its tail from time to time, and the vague fire spirit around it was calm and restrained. Chen Mo took a deep breath and took out the Yin Po Sword he got from the canyon.
The sword body is completely black, absorbing all light. The biting evil spirit slowly disperses, and countless dead ghosts rise and fall inside the sword body. He concentrated his spiritual power into the sword body, and the long sword immediately made a low hum, and a jet-black sword energy struck out silently, with unparalleled power. But the turbulent violent energy in the sword also counterattacked, rushing along the meridians towards the sea of ​​consciousness, making his mind restless and killing thoughts surging.
This was the case after several attempts. The sword was extremely powerful, but the evil intrusion could not be avoided, and he never dared to use it with all his strength.
Just as he was secretly thinking about countermeasures, the door opened without any wind, and Han Dong and Han Qingyuan walked in following the sinister aura leaking out.
Han Qingyuan looked surprised when he saw the black sword: "This sword has such a strong Yin energy, no wonder it's difficult for my junior brother to control it."
Chen Mo quickly put away his sword and saluted: "Master, senior sister. This sword has a very strong evil aura. As soon as the disciple exerts his power with all his strength, the evil aura will invade his mind. Please give me some advice, Master."
Han Dong's eyes fell on the Yin Po Sword. The indifference he had faced before about life and death was gone, and there was obvious joy in his eyes. He stepped forward to explore the air for a moment, and then slowly said: "This is a top-grade spiritual sword, the Yin Po Sword. It is forged with the evil energy of dead souls. The sword energy can devour souls and hurt the spirit. In the dark night and underworld, its power can be increased by another three points. It is a rare killing treasure."
"It's just that there is so much violence in the sword. With your current level of cultivation, it's hard for your soul to resist the erosion. This is why you are restrained."
Before he finished speaking, Han Dong raised his hand and flicked it.The light talisman floated into Chen Mo's palm.
"This is a low-grade magic weapon, the Heart Purification Talisman." He said in a calm tone, "Wear it close to your body, and the talisman will continue to emit pure spiritual energy, stabilize your sea of consciousness, and isolate the evil spirit and inner demons in the sword. With its help, you can let go of your hands and feet and use this sword with all your strength, without having to worry about being disturbed."
Chen Mo clenched the warm talisman in his hand and felt a pure power slowly flowing through his body. He immediately bowed and bowed deeply: "Thank you, Master, for the talisman!"
"The problem is completely solved now." Han Qingyuan smiled, sincerely happy for him, "Junior brother will be able to greatly increase his strength in the future with the help of this treasure."
Han Dong nodded slightly and warned: "It's a rare opportunity to refine the sword. Keep practicing diligently and don't let fate down."
Chen Mo accepted the order. The little white fox at the corner of the table raised its head, shook its furry tail, and the flame breath around its body swayed slightly, seeming to be happy for its owner.
Now that the spirit fox possesses the power of the Fire Lotus and can freely retract it, he has the Yin Soul Sword in his hand, and the Pure Heart Talisman on his body to suppress evil spirits. He no longer has any worries, and can finally study this strange sword with peace of mind, and firmly step on the path of cultivation.
